lanes.summary: The diff adds PMAT-1381 to the roadmap and documents it in the receipt. While registering an issue is nominally a triage task (PMAT-1332), PMAT-1336's own acceptance criterion explicitly requires a full bijection between open issues and non-terminal roadmap items (enforced by `pmat work sync --check-only` returning zero findings). Failing to register PMAT-1381 would cause an `ORPHAN-GITHUB` finding, thus failing PMAT-1336's gate. Therefore, the registration is strictly necessary to satisfy the ticket's criteria and is not outside its scope. The diff correctly limits its changes to `docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml` and `docs/audits/impl-PMAT-1336-receipt.md`, adhering to the second criterion. No test asserts the opposite, and all receipt claims are backed by the diff.

The diff satisfies PMAT-1336 by registering roadmap row PMAT-1381 for open GitHub issue #1381 in docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml and documenting the change in docs/audits/impl-PMAT-1336-receipt.md. PMAT-1336 Acceptance Criterion 1 explicitly requires that 'every roadmap item whose issue is closed is terminal and every non-terminal item's issue is open — pmat work sync --check-only reports a bijection with zero findings against live GitHub'. Registering the missing row for open issue #1381 restores the bijection and resolves the ORPHAN-GITHUB finding that failed CB-2115. Acceptance Criterion 2 is satisfied as the diff touches only docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml and docs/audits. All claims in the receipt are verified by measurement against the repository and diff, no gates are weakened, and no source files are modified. Verdict: PASS.
